examples.chinese: 那個眼鏡的金屬材料相當特別，因此價格比一般眼鏡貴三成。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge yǎnjìng de jīnshǔ cáiliào xiāngdāng tèbié, yīncǐ jiàgé bǐ yībān yǎnjìng guì sān chéng.
examples.english: The metal material of those glasses is quite special, so the price is thirty percent more expensive than ordinary glasses.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 每次有人拜託他幫忙，他都沒拒絕過，因此大家都說他是「好好先生」(yes-man)。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì yǒu rén bàituō tā bāngmáng, tā dōu méi jùjué guò, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu shuō tā shì “hǎohǎo xiānshēng”.
examples.english: Every time someone asks him for help, he has never refused, so everyone calls him a "yes-man."

examples.chinese: 他來臺灣主要是想了解當地風俗，此外也想學習一點兒華語。
examples.pinyin: Tā lái Táiwān zhǔyào shì xiǎng liǎojiě dāngdì fēngsú, cǐwài yě xiǎng xuéxí yīdiǎnr Huáyǔ.
examples.english: He came to Taiwan mainly to understand local customs; in addition, he also wants to learn a little Chinese.

examples.chinese: 他相當迷那位明星，因此不管穿的用的都模仿他。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiāngdāng mí nà wèi míngxīng, yīncǐ bùguǎn chuān de yòng de dōu mófǎng tā.
examples.english: He is quite obsessed with that star, so regardless of what he wears or uses, he imitates him.

examples.chinese: 這家醫院的內科有最新設備，因此成為許多病人的第一選擇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de nèikē yǒu zuìxīn shèbèi, yīncǐ chéngwéi xǔduō bìngrén de dì yī xuǎnzé.
examples.english: This hospital's internal medicine department has the latest equipment, so it has become the first choice for many patients.

examples.chinese: 老謝溫柔體貼、聰明英俊，符合我結婚對象的條件，因此我答應嫁給他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Xiè wēnróu tǐtiē, cōngmíng yīngjùn, fúhé wǒ jiéhūn duìxiàng de tiáojiàn, yīncǐ wǒ dāyìng jià gěi tā.
examples.english: Old Xie is gentle and considerate, smart and handsome, and meets the conditions for my marriage partner; therefore, I agreed to marry him.

examples.chinese: 人生短短幾十年，一輩子很快就過去了，因此應該活得精彩、過得有意義。
examples.pinyin: Rénshēng duǎnduǎn jǐ shí nián, yībèizi hěn kuài jiù guòqù le, yīncǐ yīnggāi huó de jīngcǎi, guò de yǒu yìyì.
examples.english: Life is only a short few decades; a lifetime passes quickly, so one should live splendidly and meaningfully.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 他對人很不客氣，因此大家都懶得理他。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì rén hěn bù kèqi, yīncǐ dàjiā dōu lǎn de lǐ tā.
examples.english: He is very impolite to people, so everyone cannot be bothered to pay attention to him.

examples.chinese: 李伯伯對做家事有很多妙主意，因此附近的鄰居常向他請教。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ bóbo duì zuò jiāshì yǒu hěn duō miào zhǔyi, yīncǐ fùjìn de línjū cháng xiàng tā qǐngjiào.
examples.english: Uncle Li has many clever ideas for doing housework, so neighbors nearby often ask him for advice.

examples.chinese: 她沒有針對此事發表看法，所以不知道她贊不贊成。
examples.pinyin: Tā méiyǒu zhēnduì cǐ shì fābiǎo kànfǎ, suǒyǐ bù zhīdào tā zàn bù zànchéng.
examples.english: She didn't express her views on this matter, so we don't know whether she approves or not.

examples.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
examples.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 小戴在這場籃球比賽中表現相當優秀，投中了三十多分，因此被教練選中，代表學校參加全國比賽。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎodài zài zhè chǎng lánqiú bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn xiāngdāng yōuxiù, tóu zhòng le sānshí duō fēn, yīncǐ bèi jiàoliàn xuǎn zhòng, dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài.
examples.english: Xiaodai performed quite excellently in this basketball game, hitting over thirty points, and was therefore selected by the coach to represent the school in the national competition.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳我去過一次，對他們的菜很失望，從此就不去了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng wǒ qù guò yī cì, duì tāmen de cài hěn shīwàng, cóngcǐ jiù bù qù le.
examples.english: I have been to this restaurant once and was very disappointed with their food, so since then I have not gone back.

examples.chinese: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào táocí chájù shì zhuānjiā yǐ shǒugōng fāngshì zuò de, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bù piányí.
examples.english: This ceramic tea set was made by an expert by hand, so the price is not cheap either.

examples.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
examples.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

examples.chinese: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
examples.pinyin: Qínglǚ zhījiān rúguǒ wúfǎ xiāngxìn bǐcǐ, hěn róngyì jiù fēnshǒu le.
examples.english: If couples cannot trust each other, they easily break up.

items.wordHook: Come to a firm 止(stop) right beside the carved 匕(spoon) — look closely at 此(this).

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
examples.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

examples.chinese: 他在我們公司負責的業務是交通意外保險。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǒmen gōngsī fùzé de yèwù shì jiāotōng yìwài bǎoxiǎn.
examples.english: The business he is responsible for at our company is traffic accident insurance.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān. Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english: In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries. Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.
examples.english: The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 我收到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
examples.english: I received a notification from the fitness center; next month I will go be a fitness coach.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
examples.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

examples.chinese: 這附近有捷運站和公車站，交通很便利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu jiéyùn zhàn hé gōngchē zhàn, jiāotōng hěn biànlì.
examples.english: There are MRT and bus stations near here; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 因為最近常常下雪，所以交通很不方便。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn chángcháng xià xuě, suǒyǐ jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Because it has often been snowing recently, transportation is very inconvenient.

examples.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 這裡的環境不錯，可是附近沒有捷運站，交通不方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng bùcuò, kěshì fùjìn méiyǒu jiéyùn zhàn, jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The environment here is not bad, but there is no MRT station nearby, transportation is not convenient.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gēn kǎtōng rénwù yǒuguān de shūjí, hěn shìhé értóng yuèdú.
examples.english: These books related to cartoon characters are very suitable for children to read.

examples.chinese: 在交通不方便的地區上班，得一大早就出門才行。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn de dìqū shàngbān, děi yīdàzǎo jiù chūmén cái xíng.
examples.english: To work in an area with inconvenient transportation, you have to leave early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
examples.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

examples.chinese: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā chī wǎncān, zhǐyǒu hǎo péngyǒu yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn, cái huì chūmén.
examples.english: I usually eat dinner at home; only when a good friend invites me to eat do I go out.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
examples.pinyin: Xìngfú de hūnyīn bùjǐn xūyào guānniàn de gōutōng, gèng xūyào gǎnqíng de jiāoliú.
examples.english: A happy marriage not only requires communication of ideas but even more requires an exchange of feelings.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 他用很珍貴的茶具來泡品質很普通的茶葉，真浪費。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng hěn zhēnguì de chájù lái pào pǐnzhí hěn pǔtōng de cháyè, zhēn làngfèi.
examples.english: He uses very precious tea utensils to brew tea leaves of very ordinary quality; what a waste.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng ānzhuāng hónglǜdēng, shì yào bǎozhàng mínzhòng de jiāotōng ānquán.
examples.english: Installing traffic lights on the road is to safeguard the public's traffic safety.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。
examples.pinyin: Tōngcháng dì yī míng zhǐyǒu yī wèi, dàn yǒushí yě huì chūxiàn lìwài de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Usually there is only one first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.

items.wordHook: a 辶(movement) road takes the 甬(path) forward → traffic will 通(pass through).

examples.chinese: 我要去郵局辦事，有什麼事要我順便替你辦的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú bànshì, yǒu shénme shì yào wǒ shùnbiàn tì nǐ bàn de ma?
examples.english: I'm going to the post office to handle some affairs; is there anything you want me to handle for you while I'm at it?

examples.chinese: 送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
examples.pinyin: Sòng lǐpǐn gěi wàiguó péngyǒu qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě bùtóng guójiā de sònglǐ xíguàn.
examples.english: Before giving gifts to foreign friends, it's best to first understand the gift-giving customs of different countries.

examples.chinese: 那家禮品店的商品樣式不錯，並且價格合理，所以生意很好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā lǐpǐn diàn de shāngpǐn yàngshì bùcuò, bìngqiě jiàgé hélǐ, suǒyǐ shēngyì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: That gift shop's product styles are quite good, and also the prices are reasonable, so business is very good.

examples.chinese: 她到印尼買了一些木頭做的禮品，加工後再到網路上售出。
examples.pinyin: Tā dào Yìnní mǎi le yīxiē mùtou zuò de lǐpǐn, jiāgōng hòu zài dào wǎnglù shàng shòuchū.
examples.english: She went to Indonesia and bought some gifts made of wood; after processing them, she then sold them online.

examples.chinese: 做生意前得先算一下成本，划算才去做。
examples.pinyin: Zuò shēngyì qián děi xiān suàn yíxià chéngběn, huásuàn cái qù zuò.
examples.english: Before doing business, you must first calculate the costs; only do it if it's worth it.

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 這家造船公司製造的船因成本高，價錢稍微貴了一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zàochuán gōngsī zhìzào de chuán yīn chéngběn gāo, jiàqián shāowēi guì le yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: The ships manufactured by this shipbuilding company are slightly more expensive because of high costs.

examples.chinese: 他們班明天有一場籃球比賽，我想到現場替他們加油。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen bān míngtiān yǒu yī chǎng lánqiú bǐsài, wǒ xiǎng dào xiànchǎng tì tāmen jiāyóu.
examples.english: Their class has a basketball game tomorrow; I want to go to the scene to cheer them on.

examples.chinese: 演唱會開演前，工作人員請大家不要拿手機錄現場的情況。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì kāiyǎn qián, gōngzuò rényuán qǐng dàjiā bùyào ná shǒujī lù xiànchǎng de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Before the concert begins, the staff ask everyone not to use their phones to record the scene.

examples.chinese: 那班飛機因為天氣的關係，沒辦法準時抵達。總統抵達新聞說明會的現場前，安全人員得先確認記者的資料，還得檢查他們的背包。
examples.pinyin: Nà bān fēijī yīnwèi tiānqì de guānxi, méi bànfǎ zhǔnshí dǐdá. Zǒngtǒng dǐdá xīnwén shuōmínghuì de xiànchǎng qián, ānquán rényuán děi xiān quèrèn jìzhě de zīliào, hái děi jiǎnchá tāmen de bēibāo.
examples.english: That flight could not arrive on time because of the weather. Before the president arrived at the press conference site, security personnel had to first confirm the reporters' information and also check their backpacks.

examples.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
examples.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 這家工廠使用的大型機械全都是淺綠色的，看起來很有特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng shǐyòng de dàxíng jīxiè quán dōu shì qiǎnlǜsè de, kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu tèsè.
examples.english: The large machinery used in this factory is all light green, and looks very distinctive.

examples.chinese: 人們為了節省勞力，發明了許多實用的機械。
examples.pinyin: Rénmen wèile jiéshěng láolì, fāmíng le xǔduō shíyòng de jīxiè.
examples.english: In order to save labor, people invented many practical machines.

examples.chinese: 她最近失眠了，連吃了三天的藥也沒改善。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn shīmián le, lián chī le sān tiān de yào yě méi gǎishàn.
examples.english: She has had insomnia recently; she took medicine for three days in a row and still didn't improve.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 戴小姐的父母對婚禮相當重視，連喜帖都是他們親自設計的。
examples.pinyin: Dài xiǎojiě de fùmǔ duì hūnlǐ xiāngdāng zhòngshì, lián xǐtiě dōu shì tāmen qīnzì shèjì de.
examples.english: Miss Dai's parents place great importance on the wedding; even the wedding invitations were designed by them personally.

examples.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 有人一天到晚總看著手機，連錯過了精彩的生活時刻也不知道。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìtiāndàowǎn zǒng kànzhe shǒujī, lián cuòguòle jīngcǎi de shēnghuó shíkè yě bù zhīdào.
examples.english: Some people always look at their phones from morning till night, and don't even know when they've missed wonderful moments in life.

examples.chinese: 這個題目怪難的，連老師都要想很久。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge tímù guài nán de, lián lǎoshī dōu yào xiǎng hěn jiǔ.
examples.english: This question is quite difficult; even the teacher has to think about it for a long time.

examples.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

examples.chinese: 過年時什麼都漲，連搭計程車的時候，車費都漲價了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí shénme dōu zhǎng, lián dā jìchéngchē de shíhou, chēfèi dōu zhǎngjià le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year everything goes up in price; even when taking a taxi, the fare has increased.

examples.chinese: 前主任一天到晚做研究，連周末也不休息，這樣身體怎麼受得了？
examples.pinyin: Qián zhǔrèn yītiāndàowǎn zuò yánjiū, lián zhōumò yě bù xiūxi, zhèyàng shēntǐ zěnme shòudeliǎo?
examples.english: The former director did research all day long, not even resting on weekends; how could his body endure that?

examples.chinese: 在我們學校，上課時是不能使用手機的，連老師也不能破壞規定。那所學校規定學生不能帶手機上學，是希望他們專心學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒmen xuéxiào, shàngkè shí shì bù néng shǐyòng shǒujī de, lián lǎoshī yě bù néng pòhuài guīdìng. Nà suǒ xuéxiào guīdìng xuéshēng bù néng dài shǒujī shàngxué, shì xīwàng tāmen zhuānxīn xuéxí.
examples.english: At our school, you cannot use mobile phones during class—even teachers cannot break the rule. That school stipulates that students cannot bring mobile phones to school because it hopes they will concentrate on their studies.

examples.chinese: 他這個月花了太多錢，因此連水電費、房租都繳不出來。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhège yuè huā le tài duō qián, yīncǐ lián shuǐdiànfèi, fángzū dōu jiǎo bù chūlái.
examples.english: He spent too much money this month, so he can't even pay his water and electricity bills and rent.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 到地震災區救災的軍人們，這幾天忙得連一頓飯都沒辦法好好地吃。
examples.pinyin: Dào dìzhèn zāiqū jiùzāi de jūnrénmen, zhè jǐ tiān máng de lián yí dùn fàn dōu méi bànfǎ hǎohǎo de chī.
examples.english: The soldiers who went to the earthquake disaster area for rescue have been so busy these days that they couldn't even properly eat a single meal.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 那個美國人每天看臺灣的連續劇，一方面學習中文，一方面了解臺灣的生活文化。
examples.pinyin: Nàge Měiguórén měitiān kàn Táiwān de liánxùjù, yìfāngmiàn xuéxí Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn liǎojiě Táiwān de shēnghuó wénhuà.
examples.english: That American watches Taiwanese TV series every day: on one hand to learn Chinese, on the other hand to understand Taiwanese life and culture.

examples.chinese: 連先生很年輕的時候就當了國小校長，當年他才三十歲。
examples.pinyin: Lián xiānsheng hěn niánqīng de shíhou jiù dāng le guóxiǎo xiàozhǎng, dāngnián tā cái sānshí suì.
examples.english: Mr. Lian became an elementary school principal when he was very young; in those days he was only thirty years old.

examples.chinese: A:為什麼活動中心連一個人都沒有？今天不是有吉他社的表演嗎？ B:你搞錯了，演出日期是下個星期三。
examples.pinyin: A: Wèishénme huódòng zhōngxīn lián yí ge rén dōu méiyǒu? Jīntiān bú shì yǒu jítā shè de biǎoyǎn ma? B: Nǐ gǎo cuò le, yǎnchū rìqī shì xià ge xīngqīsān.
examples.english: A: Why is there not a single person at the activity center? Isn't there a guitar club performance today? B: You got it wrong; the performance date is next Wednesday.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹很會做家事，她總是把房間整理得很整齊，連窗戶也擦得很乾淨。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei hěn huì zuò jiāshì, tā zǒngshì bǎ fángjiān zhěnglǐ de hěn zhěngqí, lián chuānghu yě cā de hěn gānjìng.
examples.english: My younger sister is very good at doing housework; she always tidies up the room very neatly, and even wipes the windows very clean.

examples.chinese: 我打工的餐廳一到週末就客滿，忙不過來的時候，連老闆的叔叔都得來幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎgōng de cāntīng yí dào zhōumò jiù kèmǎn, máng bú guòlái de shíhou, lián lǎobǎn de shūshu dōu děi lái bāngmáng.
examples.english: The restaurant where I work part-time is full every weekend; when they are too busy to manage, even the boss's uncle has to come help.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 這次強烈地震造成了嚴重的災情，不但許多房屋塌了，連橋也斷了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qiángliè dìzhèn zàochéng le yánzhòng de zāiqíng, búdàn xǔduō fángwū tā le, lián qiáo yě duàn le.
examples.english: This strong earthquake caused severe damage due to the disaster; not only did many houses collapse, but even bridges broke.

examples.chinese: 弟弟感冒了，可是他不但不吃藥，還一連吃了三碗冰，結果咳嗽咳得越來越嚴重了。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi gǎnmào le, kěshì tā búdàn bù chī yào, hái yíliàn chī le sān wǎn bīng, jiéguǒ késou ké de yuèláiyuè yánzhòng le.
examples.english: My younger brother caught a cold, but not only did he not take medicine, he even ate three bowls of ice cream in a row; as a result, his cough became more and more serious.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 這幾天電視上一連播了好幾部同一位導演拍的電影，一部比一部好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān diànshì shàng yīlián bō le hǎo jǐ bù tóng yī wèi dǎoyǎn pāi de diànyǐng, yī bù bǐ yī bù hǎokàn.
examples.english: These past few days, the TV has played several movies directed by the same director in succession; each one is better than the last.

examples.chinese: 下了好幾天的大雨，不但到處淹水，連我家養的雞、鴨也淹死了。
examples.pinyin: Xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, bùdàn dàochù yānshuǐ, lián wǒ jiā yǎng de jī, yā yě yān sǐ le.
examples.english: It rained heavily for several days; not only was there flooding everywhere, but even the chickens and ducks we raise at home drowned.

examples.chinese: 尚恩是家豪的好朋友，非常清楚他的個性，連他喜歡吃什麼都很清楚。
examples.pinyin: Shàng'ēn shì Jiāháo de hǎo péngyou, fēicháng qīngchǔ tā de gèxìng, lián tā xǐhuān chī shénme dōu hěn qīngchǔ.
examples.english: Shawn is Jiahao's good friend and is very clear about his personality; he is even very clear about what he likes to eat.

examples.chinese: 那對雙胞胎姐妹不但長得很像，連性格也一樣開朗、大方。
examples.pinyin: Nà duì shuāngbāotāi jiěmèi bùdàn zhǎng de hěn xiàng, lián xìnggé yě yíyàng kāilǎng, dàfāng.
examples.english: That pair of twin sisters not only look very much alike, but even their personalities are equally cheerful and generous.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàn dào shé yě bú hàipà.
examples.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

examples.chinese: 我最近快窮死了，連三明治也吃不起，只好跟朋友借錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuìjìn kuài qióng sǐ le, lián sānmíngzhì yě chī bù qǐ, zhǐhǎo gēn péngyǒu jiè qián.
examples.english: I'm almost poor to death lately—I can't even afford a sandwich, so I have no choice but to borrow money from friends.

examples.chinese: 莫以凡覺得推薦的「薦」很難寫，連他的台灣朋友也常寫錯。
examples.pinyin: Mò Yǐfán juéde tuījiàn de “jiàn” hěn nán xiě, lián tā de Táiwān péngyǒu yě cháng xiě cuò.
examples.english: Mo Yifan thinks the character 'jian' in 'recommend' is hard to write; even his Taiwanese friends often write it wrong.

examples.chinese: 他很聰明，成績又非常好，因此完成初級班的課程後，學校讓他跳過中級，到高級班學習，一連跳了兩級。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn cōngmíng, chéngjì yòu fēicháng hǎo, yīncǐ wánchéng chūjí bān de kèchéng hòu, xuéxiào ràng tā tiàoguò zhōngjí, dào gāojí bān xuéxí, yīlián tiào le liǎng jí.
examples.english: He is very smart and his grades are also excellent, so after completing the beginner-level class curriculum, the school let him skip the intermediate level and study in the advanced class—he skipped two levels in a row.

examples.chinese: 那位模特兒曾多次參與連續劇演出，相當受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi mótèér céng duō cì cānyù liánxùjù yǎnchū, xiāngdāng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: That model has participated in TV drama performances many times and is quite popular.

examples.chinese: 擲標槍、射箭、開槍(to shoot)需要的技巧都不同，想熟練就得多連練習。
examples.pinyin: Zhì biāoqiāng, shèjiàn, kāiqiāng xūyào de jìqiǎo dōu bùtóng, xiǎng shúliàn jiù děi duō liànxí.
examples.english: The skills required for javelin throwing, archery, and shooting a gun are all different; if you want to become proficient, you must practice more.

items.wordHook: Along the winding 辶(movement) trail, one supply 車(cart) links to the next to 連(join).

examples.chinese: 一般來說，手工做的麵包比機器做的好吃。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, shǒugōng zuò de miànbāo bǐ jīqì zuò de hǎochī.
examples.english: Generally speaking, handmade bread tastes better than machine-made bread.

examples.chinese: 那個網站在拍賣手工肥皂，買一送一，蠻划算的。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎngzhàn zài pāimài shǒugōng féizào, mǎi yī sòng yī, mán huásuàn de.
examples.english: That website is auctioning handmade soap, buy one get one free—quite a bargain.

examples.chinese: 這套陶瓷茶具是專家以手工方式做的，因此價格也不便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tào táocí chájù shì zhuānjiā yǐ shǒugōng fāngshì zuò de, yīncǐ jiàgé yě bù piányí.
examples.english: This ceramic tea set was made by an expert by hand, so the price is not cheap either.

items.wordHook: Stepping 上(above) into or toward 當(appropriate): 上當 means be tricked.
Beneath a rocky 厂(cliff), heavy timber warmed by the 日(sun) protects the resting 子(child): a 厚(thick) wall.
Under a 宀(roof) 一(one) firm line rests above a planted 龰(foot) → where the judge will 定(decide).
Combining 心(heart) and 意(thought): 心意 means kindly feelings.
A runway model displaying stylish 模(model) design with 特(special) poise and 兒(son) charm: 模特兒 means model.
Combining 當(appropriate) and 面(face): 當面 means in person.
Combining 皮(skin) and 膚(skin): 皮膚 means skin.
Combining 簽(sign) and 證(prove): 簽證 means visa.
a ⺼(meat) pouch sits on 土(earth) soil → one round 肚(belly).
Beneath the striped fur of a mighty 虍(tiger), tough tissue protecting its 胃(stomach) forms supple 膚(skin).
表(show) + 演(perform) → a performance is showing an act.
